//: EAS Build profiles. Each `build` profile is a recipe passed to `eas build --profile <name>`. Docs: https://docs.expo.dev/build/eas-json/

build.//development: For daily development — installs a debug client on your phone that connects to a Metro dev server. Replaces Expo Go for anything Expo Go can't run (Bluetooth, background tasks, custom native modules).
build.//preview: For internal QA — a signed release APK that behaves like production but is distributed via a shareable link (not Play Store). Install directly on the mall's tablet during closed testing.
build.//production: For Play Store submission — an Android App Bundle (AAB, not APK). Google requires AAB. Do NOT install this directly; go through Play Console.

submit.//production: One-command Play Store submission after a production build finishes. Requires a Google service-account JSON path — see SIGNING_KEYSTORE.md.
